story_title: Buy it in ChatGPT: Instant Checkout and the Agentic Commerce Protocol
caption:
OpenAI just took its first concrete steps toward agentic commerce.

With 'Buy it in ChatGPT' and the new Agentic Commerce Protocol, ChatGPT is transitioning from an assistant that recommends products to an agent capable of completing purchases directly.

This shift moves AI from an information interface to an active economic participant.

What do you think—would you let an AI handle checkouts for you?

alt_text_overall: Carousel detailing OpenAI's announcement of Buy it in ChatGPT, Instant Checkout, and the Agentic Commerce Protocol.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: CHATGPT JUST GOT AN INSTANT CHECKOUT BUTTON.. OpenAI has announced the first steps toward agentic commerce inside ChatGPT. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: AI IS NO LONGER JUST RECOMMENDING.. Instead of sending you to external websites via links, ChatGPT is built to let users and businesses shop together directly. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: THE AGENTIC COMMERCE PROTOCOL.. OpenAI outlined a structured mechanism designed for people, AI agents, and merchants to transact seamlessly. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: FROM CHATBOT TO ECONOMIC AGENT.. When AI moves from information retrieval to executing payments, the entire traditional e-commerce funnel changes. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
Slide 5: BUY IT IN CHATGPT.. The chat interface is officially becoming a storefront. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: OPTIMIZING FOR AGENTS, NOT HUMANS.. Brands will soon compete for AI agent selection rather than traditional web ad clicks and visual store layouts. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
Slide 7: THE ERA OF AGENTIC COMMERCE IS OPENING.. AI is no longer just answering your questions. It is preparing to manage your transactions. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
